text_block_list.text:
I arrive at the track for Vodka's
training.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sure am! I ate a bunch on my day off and
slept
like a baby.
choice_data_list: You seem to be doing well!
You seem to be doing well!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I even got to knock out my backlog of
motorcycle
magazines.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Now I've got a full tank of gas and I'm
ready to
run with all I've got!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'll be coming full-throttle out of the
gate—I'll
blow everyone's minds!
